description: CALL ... RETURNING status-item, ISO §2023:14.9.4 - the RETURNING phrase is a COBOL-2002 introduction (folded from the inline CallBinder gate, Exec Step E). THE EDGE IS QUOTED from the edition texts (kb/Work PB3965): the ANSI X3.23-1985 CALL statement names the called program by literal-1 or identifier-1 alone (§1985:X.5.2.2, whose formats print `CALL {identifier-1 | literal-1} [USING ... BY CONTENT { identifier-2 } ...]` then ON OVERFLOW imperative-statement-1 or [NOT] ON EXCEPTION and END-CALL; §1985:X.5.2.4 GR1: "Literal-1 or the content of the data item referenced by identifier-1 is the name of the called program"), a result coming back only through a BY REFERENCE parameter, §1985:II.6.4.2.2: "Thus a parameter passed by reference may be used by a called program to return a result to the calling program whereas a parameter passed by content cannot be so used"; §2002:F.1 item 6 ("The following reserved words have been added") lists RETURNING. Every 2002 CALL format prints `[ RETURNING identifier-3 ]` after the USING phrase, §2002:14.8.4.2 SR7: "Identifier-3 shall reference a data item defined in the file, working-storage, local-storage, linkage, or communication section" and SR9: "Identifier-3 is a receiving operand". §2014:14.9.4.2 SR7 and §2023:14.9.4.3 SR7 carry the rule (2014 drops only the communication section); §2023:14.9.4.4 GR4: "If a RETURNING phrase is specified, the result of the activated program is placed into identifier-3".

IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
PROGRAM-ID. RWCRET.
DATA DIVISION.
WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
77 RC PIC 99 VALUE 0.
PROCEDURE DIVISION.
MAIN.
    CALL "RWCRSUB" RETURNING RC.
    STOP RUN.
END PROGRAM RWCRET.
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
PROGRAM-ID. RWCRSUB.
DATA DIVISION.
LINKAGE SECTION.
01 LR PIC 99.
PROCEDURE DIVISION RETURNING LR.
MAIN.
    MOVE 5 TO LR.
    GOBACK.
END PROGRAM RWCRSUB.
